story.title: The Great Tomato Launchpad
story.question: How did Barnaby sell his rogue produce sorting machine at the bustling farmers market?
story.answer: By showcasing its incredible tomato-peeling precision directly to terrified shoppers.

story_beats.headline: A Chaotic Discovery
story_beats.speech: Behold the citrus cannon ninety thousand, a marvel designed to organize every single unruly fruit in this chaotic market!
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands proudly behind a market stall holding a copper wrench, pointing at a clunky mechanical sorting robot with spinning steel arms.

story_beats.headline: Constructing The Fix
story_beats.speech: We must tighten these gears immediately before the angry farmers realize our automated peeler is targeting their hats!
story_beats.label: Assembly
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically adjusts a glowing green calibration dial on the robot chestplate while red warning signal lights flash brightly overhead.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Test
story_beats.speech: Watch carefully as the high velocity mechanism isolates each red sphere with absolute perfection and zero collateral damage.
story_beats.label: Operation
story_beats.visual_prompt: The robot scoops a giant tomato and launches it through a hoop shaped like a mini airship into a neatly stacked crate.

story_beats.headline: Market Triumph
story_beats.speech: Success at last! Every single merchant is cheering because our frantic contraption finally saved their entire morning harvest.
story_beats.label: Resolution
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby and smiling market vendors stand in front of a swinging wooden stall door, holding up bags of gold coins and laughing.

visual_bible.style: Bright stop-motion claymation with vibrant marketplace colors and whimsical steampunk machinery.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild gray hair, wearing a patched tweed vest, round spectacles, and a stained apron.

locations.Market Square: A bustling outdoor bazaar with colorful canvas awnings, wooden crates, and hanging lanterns.

objects.Sorting Robot: A bulky brass and iron machine with three mechanical arms, glowing green sensor eyes, and a loud exhaust pipe.
objects.Copper Wrench: A heavy, dented tool used for fixing stubborn clockwork gears.

story.title: The Cabbage Cannon Catastrophe
story.question: Can an overzealous market inventor sell a vegetable launcher before the produce rots?
story.answer: Yes, by accidentally inventing the world's first airborne salad delivery service.

story_beats.headline: The Market Debut
story_beats.speech: Behold the rapid-fire cabbage catapult, guaranteed to deliver fresh greens across the entire village square without any bruising!
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: Inventor Barnaby stands proudly next to a quirky wooden spring-loaded cannon in the crowded cobblestone marketplace, smiling widely while pointing at a loaded round cabbage.

story_beats.headline: The Tension Mounts
story_beats.speech: Quickly load the heavy brass tension lever before the angry grocers notice our experimental trial run starting right now.
story_beats.label: The Adjustment
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically cranks a squeaky brass lever on the side of the wooden cannon, while nervous market vendor Martha glares at him with hands on her hips.

story_beats.headline: The Catastrophic Launch
story_beats.speech: Oops, I accidentally set the launch angle too high, sending twenty heads of cabbage straight into the bakery chimney!
story_beats.label: The Mishap
story_beats.visual_prompt: The wooden cannon fires upward with a loud pop, launching a flurry of green cabbages through the air toward a smoking stone bakery chimney in the background.

story_beats.headline: The Sweet Success
story_beats.speech: Customers love the pre-shredded baked coleslaw falling from the sky, making our disastrous launch a profitable culinary masterpiece today.
story_beats.label: The Solution
story_beats.visual_prompt: Astonished villagers cheer and hold out bowls as warm, perfectly shredded cooked cabbage rains down gently from above near the front door of the bakery.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful stop-motion animation aesthetic with detailed textures and comedic character expressions.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild ginger hair, round wire spectacles, a patched blue vest, and grease-stained trousers.
characters.Martha: A stern market vendor wearing a crisp white apron, a pink headscarf, and carrying a woven wicker basket.

locations.marketplace: A bustling medieval village square filled with wooden stalls, hanging canvas awnings, and cobblestone pathways.

objects.cannon: A quirky spring-loaded wooden launcher painted bright red with brass rivets and a squeaky crank handle.
objects.cabbage: A plump, oversized round green head of cabbage with slightly frayed outer leaves.

story.title: The Weaver's Last Loom
story.question: Can true friendship survive a village-wide choice between warmth and survival?
story.answer: Yes, by dismantling the final loom together to build a communal hearth for the entire valley.

story_beats.headline: The Hidden Secret
story_beats.speech: My oldest friend, our grandfather's secret blueprints show this ancient forest harbors enough hidden timber to save everyone.
story_beats.label: The Discovery
story_beats.visual_prompt: An elderly village weaver in brown woolen robes stands inside a dense, misty forest holding a glowing wooden signal baton, discovering a hidden ancient door carved into a giant oak tree trunk.

story_beats.headline: The Impossible Choice
story_beats.speech: If we cut down the grove for winter heat, the ancient loom that feeds our village families will never weave again.
story_beats.label: The Dilemma
story_beats.visual_prompt: The weaver and his carpenter friend stand in the snowy village square before a massive stone door, pointing at a wooden schematic scroll held firmly in the carpenter's calloused hands.

story_beats.headline: The Shared Act
story_beats.speech: Instead of arguing, we must break apart our family heritage and forge a brand new path through unified sacrifice.
story_beats.label: The Turning Point
story_beats.visual_prompt: The two friends work together at dusk in the village square, using heavy iron mallets to dismantle a towering wooden handloom while holding a bright metal signal torch aloft.

story_beats.headline: The Warm Valley
story_beats.speech: Look at the glowing smoke rising from the new central hearth; our difficult choice kept every single neighbor warm.
story_beats.label: The Resolution
story_beats.visual_prompt: The weaver and carpenter smile together on a hilltop overlooking the village at sunrise, watching thin ribbons of smoke rise from communal stone houses shaped like rustic wooden ships.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic historical realism with warm, dramatic lighting, rich earth tones, and intricate hand-crafted textures.

characters.weaver: An elderly man with deep wrinkles, kind grey eyes, wearing patched brown wool robes and a woven linen scarf.
characters.carpenter: A sturdy middle-aged woman with braided dark hair, wearing a heavy leather apron over a green tunic.

locations.forest: An ancient, misty forest filled with colossal oak trees and moss-covered forest floors.
locations.village_square: A rustic medieval village square paved with cobblestones, surrounded by timber-framed houses.

objects.blueprint_scroll: A yellowed parchment roll tied with hemp string, showing faded ink diagrams of antique timber frames.
objects.iron_mallet: A heavy blacksmithing tool with a dark iron head and a polished ashwood handle.
